description: Divides the voltage between two settings into equal intervals and carries each point of the division to its own output

params.text: Sets the voltage at the first output, -10V to 10V
Sets the voltage the division reaches at its last active output, -10V to 10V
Attenuverts the top CV before it is added to the top knob
Attenuverts the bottom CV before it is added to the bottom knob
Sets how many equal intervals the voltage span is cut into, which is one fewer than the number of outputs that carry a voltage

inputs.text: Shifts the top of the span, added to the top knob through its attenuverter and clamped to -10 to 10V
Shifts the bottom of the span, added to the bottom knob through its attenuverter and clamped to -10 to 10V
Changes the number of intervals, added to the divisions knob at 2.4 divisions per volt and clamped to at most 12

outputs.text: Carries the top voltage itself, which is the first point of the division and is present whatever the division count
Carries the point of the division that many intervals down from the top; it falls to 0V and its lamp goes dark when the division count does not reach it

notes: the outputs carry more than one channel only when a polyphonic cable is patched into TOP or BOTTOM, and the division count is always read from the first channel of DIVS

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · polyphonic

the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±10V.
inputs.1:
bipolar · continuous · polyphonic

the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±10V.
inputs.2:
stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
